result.description:
The Client
Melbourne Earthescapes Pty Ltd is a family-owned earthmoving, landscaping, and construction business based in Ravenhall, VIC, delivering landscaping, retaining wall construction, rockwork, stone installation, and transportation services across Melbourne and surrounding regions. 

They are seeking an experienced Stonemason to join their team in Ravenhall, VIC.

The Role
The Stonemason is responsible for constructing, repairing, and installing stone structures, retaining walls, masonry features, and related stonework in accordance with project specifications and construction requirements.
This is a full-time position with an annual salary of $80,000 to $90,000 plus superannuation. 

The Responsibilities
•	Cut and shape hard and soft stone blocks and masonry slabs to construct and renovate stone structures, kitchen benchtops, and monumental masonry
•	Lay pre-cut stones and masonry blocks in mortar to construct and repair walls, partitions, arches, and structural stone features
•	Study plans and specifications to determine material requirements, dimensions, and installation procedures
•	Erect and dismantle restricted height scaffolding in accordance with workplace safety procedures
•	Seal foundations with damp-resistant materials and apply mortar layers to support masonry installation works
•	Lay stones in rows, designs, and patterns while maintaining structural alignment and finish quality
•	Embed stone blocks in mortar and remove excess material to achieve clean and accurate finishes
•	Check vertical and horizontal alignment of stone structures using levelling and measuring equipment
•	Cut, shape, polish, and finish stone materials using hand tools, polishing equipment, and masonry machinery
•	Repair and maintain stone, brick, and masonry structures in accordance with construction requirements
•	Design, cut, and install monumental masonry and stone lettering works
•	Construct retaining walls, stone facades, and structural masonry installations for residential and commercial projects Choose and prepare appropriate metal materials for fabrication

The Requirements
•	Certificate III in Stonemasonry, Bricklaying, Construction, or equivalent trade qualification
•	Minimum 5 years’ experience as a Stonemason within construction, landscaping, or masonry environments
•	Minimum 5 years’ experience interpreting technical drawings, specifications, and construction measurements for masonry works
•	At least 5 years’ experience constructing retaining walls, stone structures, and masonry installations across residential or commercial projects
•	At least 5 years’ experience operating masonry tools, polishing equipment, cutting machinery, and stone fabrication tools
•	At least 5 years’ experience constructing stone retaining walls, rock walls, garden walls, paving, steps and outdoor stone features
•	Minimum 5 years’ experience using stone cutting, grinding, drilling, shaping and finishing tools in a construction or landscaping environment
•	Strong knowledge of masonry construction methods, mortar application, and stone finishing techniques
•	Ability to read and interpret technical plans, site measurements, and installation specifications accurately
•	Strong understanding of workplace safety procedures, scaffolding requirements, and construction compliance standards
•	White Card required
•	Excavator and Skid Steer licences preferred
•	Ability to work outdoors, at heights, and across varying construction site environments
•	Strong work ethic, reliability, and ability to work independently or within construction teams
•	High attention to detail and commitment to workmanship quality
result.title: Stonemason

result.description:
Mechanical Engineer positions available in all states NSW, Qld, Vic, & WA

At NEPEAN™ we are proud to be Australia’s leading privately owned engineering, mining services and industrial manufacturing organisation. We have unique capabilities to deliver high value, innovative and sustainable solutions for the world’s leading mining, construction, and transport companies. Over the last 40 years, hard work, technical credibility, and a willingness to tackle very difficult projects have earned NEPEAN an enviable reputation. Today our organisation employs over 1400 people across six continents and distributes products to more than 65 countries.

We service our customers through multiple businesses in our portfolio: NEPEAN Building and Infrastructure (Galserv, Galintel, Weldlok), NEPEAN Engineering and Innovation, NEPEAN Power, Mining (NEPEAN Longwall), PROK, NEPEAN Conveyors, NEPEAN Transport, Gurtec, Roxon, and NEPEAN Belting Mackay.

We are currently offering a fantastic opportunity for Mechanical Engineer based in our WA Office. The Mechanical Engineer will attend various customer’s mine sites and assist our valued customers with conveyor systems providing solutions to engineering-related problems. Critical to the role is the employee can develop and nurture professional, productive and harmonious working relationships with the ongoing goal of customer satisfaction, loyalty and trust.

KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES

ENGINEERING
Applying sound Mechanical Engineering practices to the safe design of conveyor equipment
Applying structural engineering practices to the safe design of conveyor equipment, including winch design and structures
Analysing inputs and outputs from many in-house design calculators and spreadsheets, written to ensure output is conforming to relevant Australian Standards
Conduct finite Element Analysis and Element Modelling using Inventor, ANSYS and Rocky
Conduct Power and tension calculations and reports for conveyor systems
Understanding the installation, operation and maintenance of industrial equipment, especially conveyors
Develop operation parts and maintenance manuals as well as commissioning documentation, SOP’s, design reviews, risk assessments etc

MODELLING AND DRAFTING
Conduct 3D modelling in Inventor to develop conveyor equipment concepts to a point that they can be detailed by the drafting team
Occasional detail drafting as required

SALES
Development and nurturing of existing PROK-client relationships
Developing new relationships with new client representatives and/or new clients
Being the primary site-based point of contact for all correspondence between the client and PROK
Develop scopes of work with the client and provide pricing sketches and work with the estimators to ensure sufficient information is communicated

PLANNING
Maintain and update a personal engineering planning sheet with your allocated clients and projects every week
Monitor and control the schedule, budget and quality of each assigned work/drawing package

TECHNICAL WRITING
Prepare clear, grammatically correct, professional operation, parts and maintenance manuals with input from engineering team, workshop, client and suppliers
Develop commissioning documentation
Participate/ develop/ complete SOPs and similar tasks

EDUCATION, QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE
Mechanical Engineering Degree and/or Structural Engineering Degree
On-site and commissioning experience desirable

SKILLS AND KNOWLEDGE
Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills
Be well organised, extremely personable and reliable. (Hands-on skills)
The ability to strategically evaluate and solve complex problems
Strong attention to detail
Adaptability and Flexibility
An understanding of organisational development
Work personality strongly aligns with NEPEAN’s DNA
Mechanical Engineering Practices
Team Player
Conflict Resolution

If you believe you the right skills, experience and passion for succeeding in this role, please submit your cover letter and resume for consideration.

NEPEAN believes in diversity and is committed to providing Equal Employment opportunities for all applicants. We welcome applicants from all walks of life which also included various socio-economic, cultural, LGBTIQ, Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander backgrounds.

Salary: $85,000 per annum + Super

result.description:
The Client 

Blaze Engineering and Sheetmetal Fabrication Pty Ltd is a metal fabrication and engineering business based in Tullamarine, VIC, specialising in sheet metal fabrication, welding, metal assembly, and engineered manufacturing solutions.  

They are seeking an experienced Welder (First Class) to join their team in Tullamarine, VIC. 

 

The Role 

The Welder (First Class) is responsible for fabricating, assembling, and repairing metal components and structures using a range of welding and fabrication techniques. 

This is a full-time position with an annual salary of $78,000 to $82,000 plus superannuation. 

 

The Responsibilities 

Select and prepare appropriate welding equipment, consumables, and materials for welding operations. 

Read and interpret technical drawings, blueprints, welding procedures, and specifications to determine welding requirements. 

Mark out and cut metal sections and components using metal-cutting machinery. 

Shape and bend metal sections and plates using machine tools. 

Set up and operate MIG welding equipment to weld, join, and repair metal components and structures. 

Position and secure workpieces to ensure accurate alignment and welding in accordance with specifications. 

Perform welding operations on various metal components while maintaining required quality and safety standards. 

Inspect completed welds to ensure compliance with specified dimensions, quality requirements, and welding standards. 

Repair defective welds and damaged metal components through grinding, gouging, and rewelding processes. 

Perform weld finishing activities, including grinding and dressing welds to achieve the required finish and appearance. 

Use measuring and testing instruments to verify weld quality, accuracy, and compliance with specifications. 

Carry out welding repairs and maintenance on metal structures, machinery, equipment, and related components. 

Clean and prepare metal surfaces before and after welding to ensure quality. 

Conduct routine maintenance and basic troubleshooting of welding equipment to ensure safe and efficient operation. 

Follow workplace health and safety procedures, welding safety requirements, and relevant industry regulations at all times. 

Work collaboratively with supervisors, engineers, inspectors, and other trades personnel to complete welding tasks efficiently. 

Maintain accurate records of welding activities, inspections, repairs, materials used, and work completed. 

 

The Requirements 

Certificate IV in Engineering or equivalent qualification 

Minimum 1.5 years’ experience as a Welder (First Class) or within metal fabrication environments 

Minimum 1.5 years’ experience performing MIG welding across structural steel and fabricated metal components 

Minimum 1.5 years’ experience interpreting engineering drawings, fabrication plans, and technical specifications 

At least 1.5 years’ experience operating fabrication machinery, welding equipment, and metalworking tools 

At least 1.5 years’ experience assembling, repairing, and finishing fabricated metal products to engineering standards 

Sound knowledge of a range of welding techniques, including TIG, flux-cored and manual metal arc welding, and their application in metal fabrication. 

Strong knowledge of welding procedures, fabrication methods, and metal finishing techniques 

Ability to identify welding defects, dimensional inconsistencies, and fabrication issues accurately 

Strong understanding of workplace safety procedures, fabrication compliance standards, and workshop operations 

Good communication skills and ability to work effectively within fabrication and engineering teams 

High attention to detail and commitment to precision workmanship

Position: Industrial Designer
Type: Full-time
Employer: Image Embroidery
Location: Canning Vale WA 6155
Salary: $147,000 p/a
About the Business:
Image Embroidery is a well-established embroidery and promotional products specialist based in Canning Vale, Perth, Western Australia. The company specialises in high-quality custom logo embroidery, digitising, and the production of corporate, sports, casual apparel, headwear, and promotional items. Known for its commitment to excellence, quick turnaround, and outstanding customer service, Image Embroidery operates in a fast-paced, dynamic environment that values creativity, attention to detail, innovation, and teamwork. The business prides itself on delivering cost-effective, high-quality solutions and building strong client relationships through professional and reliable service.
About the Position:
Image Embroidery is seeking a highly motivated Industrial Designer with a strong embroidery design focus to join our team in Canning Vale. The role involves creating and developing custom designs for embroidery and promotional products, managing design processes from concept to production, and working closely with clients, sales, and production teams to deliver high-quality outcomes within tight deadlines in a fast-paced environment. This position plays a key role in driving innovation and ensuring design excellence that supports the company’s reputation for superior promotional products.
Key Responsibilities:
Concept visualisation and sketching according to client requirements.
Consult effectively with the sales team and clients about design requirements, product designs, and resolve design concerns to meet agreed outcomes.
Investigate appropriate materials and develop production processes to ensure ability to produce cost-effective products and meet client requirements.
Ensure that timelines are aligned with production schedules and implement cost optimisation initiatives.
Ensure concepts are closely aligned to requirements through the production of detailed plot charts, blue-prints, renderings, and sample designs.
Produce technical drawings and accurately test product designs using models, prototypes, specialist computer software, and computer-aided design (CAD) technology.
Collaborate closely with the production team to resolve any product faults or manufacturing concerns relating to the design, production time, or materials issues.
Collaborate with the sales team, as required, to present designs, samples, and final work to customers for review and evaluation.
Requirements:
Australian citizens and permanent residents are encouraged to apply.
Appropriate Industrial Design / Product Design and Development qualifications.
Minimum 10 years’ relevant experience.
Advanced proficiency in CAD software, design rendering tools, and digitising software specific to embroidery and textile applications.
Strong creative and technical design skills with a keen eye for detail and ability to translate client briefs into production-ready designs.
Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with proven ability to consult with clients and collaborate effectively across sales and production teams.
Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects in a fast-paced environment while meeting strict deadlines and maintaining high quality standards.
How to Apply:
To apply, applicants must submit their resume with a valid email address through this online portal.
Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

Position: Machine Operator, Steel/Metal Industry
Location: Marrickville
Days: Mon-Fri
Hours: 38
Pay: $33+ casual rate with potential to go FT perm
Start: ASAP
 
Summary
We are seeking a skilled and dedicated Machine Operator to join our clients team in the steel industry. As a Machine Operator, you will be responsible for operating and maintaining a variety of metalworking machinery to produce high-quality metal products. Your attention to detail, technical expertise, and commitment to safety will play a crucial role in our manufacturing process.
 
Company
Based in Marrickville, our company specializes in the production of a diverse range of metal products, including tables, chairs, trolleys, and other innovative solutions. They pride in their commitment to quality craftsmanship and cutting-edge design.
 
Responsibilities
* Set up and prepare metalworking machines, including lathes, milling machines, grinders, presses, and CNC machines, for production according to specifications.
* Operate machinery to shape, cut, form, or assemble metal components used in the production of a wide range of metal products, including but not limited to Connoisseur Racks, Display Racks, Primat Racks, Strip Racks, Brackets, and Clips, ensuring adherence to quality standards and production schedules.
* Monitor machine operations and conduct regular inspections to verify product accuracy and quality, making adjustments as needed.
* Perform routine maintenance tasks on machines, including cleaning, lubricating, and replacing worn parts to ensure optimal performance.
* Follow safety guidelines and protocols rigorously to maintain a safe working environment and prevent accidents.
* Collaborate with team members, supervisors, and engineers to communicate production updates, issues, and improvements.
* Troubleshoot and resolve operational issues, such as machine malfunctions, material inconsistencies, or quality deviations, to minimize downtime.
* Maintain accurate records of production data, machine settings, maintenance activities, and any encountered issues.
* Continuously seek opportunities for process improvement and efficiency enhancement in machine operation and product quality.
* Adhere to company policies, procedures, and guidelines to maintain a productive and positive work environment.
 
Requirements
* Experience as a Machine Operator in the metal industry, with an understanding of metalworking machinery and techniques (Desirable - Training to be provided by employer)
* Proficiency in operating and troubleshooting various metalworking machines
* Solid mechanical aptitude and technical skills to perform routine maintenance and address minor mechanical issues.
* Attention to detail and precision in following instructions, measurements, and specifications.
* Excellent problem-solving skills to identify issues and implement effective solutions.
* Strong commitment to safety protocols and guidelines.
* Effective communication skills to interact with team members, supervisors, and engineers.
* Physical stamina to stand for extended periods, lift heavy materials, and perform repetitive tasks.
* Flexibility to adapt to changing production demands and learn new techniques or machinery.
* Willingness to engage in ongoing training and professional development.

Warehouse Academy is facilitating recruitment on behalf of our client. The successful applicant will be employed and paid directly by the client. Warehouse Academy is a recruitment coordination service only and is not the employer for this role.

About Burlington Berries
Burlington Berries is a leading berry production company located in the fertile Northern Midlands of Tasmania. Known for delivering high-quality strawberries, raspberries, and blackberries to major national retailers, Burlington Berries combines innovative growing techniques with sustainable farming practices. Our operations combine leading horticultural practices with a strong commitment to sustainability, innovation, and excellence in every stage of berry production. Our team is passionate about excellence in horticulture and dedicated to producing premium fresh produce for Australian consumers.

Position Overview
The full-time Irrigationist Assitant supports the planning, maintenance, and execution of irrigation systems across Burlington Berries’ production areas. Working under the direction of the Irrigationist, this role is hands-on and operationally focused, ensuring that all irrigation tasks are carried out accurately, efficiently, and in a timely manner. The role is ideal for someone looking to grow their technical skills in a fast-paced, high-yield berry farming environment.

Key Responsibilities/Tasks
Irrigation Support and Execution
•	Assist in daily irrigation operations including the setup, adjustment, and monitoring of drip lines, valves, and other water delivery infrastructure.
•	Execute irrigation schedules as directed, ensuring water application matches crop requirements across different berry varieties and stages of growth.
•	Observing the crop daily to ensure optimal fertigation programs

System Checks and Maintenance
•	Conduct routine inspections of irrigation systems to identify leaks, clogs, or wear-and-tear on components.
•	Support filter cleaning, emitter flushing, pressure checks, and other maintenance activities to ensure optimal system performance.

Data Logging and Communication
•	Record irrigation and fertigation activities as required, including volumes applied, timing, and any system faults.
•	Recording  water and fertiliser use and report on for each crop type
•	Communicate effectively with supervisors, agronomists, and other team members regarding field conditions, task completion, and issues requiring escalation.
•	Attending daily meetings to help align the irrigation/fertigation plans with the daily climatic changes and crop requirements

Infrastructure Installation and Upgrades
•	Assist with installation and modification of irrigation lines, control valves, filters, and pumps for new planting blocks or seasonal adjustments.
•	Work alongside contractors or in-house teams during major system upgrades or expansions.

Fertigation and Nutrient Delivery
•	Prepare and apply fertigation mixes under guidance, ensuring accurate dosing through injection systems.
•	Monitor fertigation equipment during runs and report any issues or anomalies promptly.

Key Skills and Attributes
•	Willingness to learn and apply technical irrigation and fertigation skills in a commercial horticulture setting.
•	Good attention to detail, especially when working with measurement, timing, and calibration tasks.
•	Reliability and a strong work ethic, including availability for early starts, weekends, and peak seasonal periods.
•	Ability to follow instructions, take initiative, and work safely in outdoor environments.
•	Interest in agriculture, irrigation, or horticulture as a career path.

Qualifications and Experience
•	A basic understanding of irrigation systems, pumps, and fertigation principles is an advantage.
•	Certificate II or III in Agriculture, Irrigation, or Horticulture and one year of work experience (at least 20+hrs per week), or have at least 2 years full time work experience in lieu of formal qualifications
•	Current driver’s licence required; machinery tickets (e.g., forklift, quad bike) are beneficial but not essential.

Salary
.       $72,000-$81,000 + Superannuation depending on experience

Due to operational expansion and the critical nature of their systems, we are seeking a dedicated IT Systems Support Technician to ensure their core industrial computing infrastructure remains online and optimized.

Role Overview
This is a highly specialized, business-critical role embedded directly within an advanced manufacturing environment. You will be responsible for the continuous, real-time monitoring of two advanced Turbo Test Duo balancing and calibration systems driven by embedded software platforms.

To confirm: This is not a mechanical repair position. The primary objective is the maintenance, troubleshooting, and support of the highly integrated computer systems, hardware interfaces, and proprietary software that governs the physical machinery.

Location: Cheltenham, VIC

Job Type: Full-time, Ongoing 

Salary $80,000 – $90,000 + Superannuation  per annum.

Responsibilities 
•	Actively oversee and analyze the operation of embedded, computer-controlled industrial systems throughout the day.

•	Instantly respond to automated software alerts and digital system alarms to isolate faults across integrated computer hardware and data logging modules.

•	Resolve complex technical issues occurring within specialized proprietary software configurations and peripheral IT components.

•	Manage, verify, and update software profiles, system parameters, and computer calibration data to guarantee operational accuracy.

•	Maintain precise digital records of system errors, technical configurations, and software performance logs to feed into predictive risk management.

Required Skills, Qualifications & Experience

•	Diploma, or higher qualification in a highly related IT discipline or agreed substitute

•	Experience: Minimum of 1–2 years of professional experience supporting integrated computer networks, automated software platforms, or industrial IT hardware interfaces.

•	Proven experience interpreting real-time software diagnostics, system logs, and bi-directional hardware/software integration.

•	Strong ability to diagnose computing faults rapidly under pressure to minimize production downtime. 

•	Excellent communication skills to interface with production engineers.

•	Ability to prioritise, multitask and work independently.

•	A passion for learning and staying ahead of technology trends.

•	Ability to analyse and evaluate complex IT issues.

•	High attention to detail and documentation accuracy

You will have unrestricted rights to work full time in Australia to be considered. 

How to Apply
